answer: An economy can make each identity carry a unique shale of verified work history that cannot be transferred or copied: joining requires completing three paid attestations from established members, and every one of those signatures is recorded against the new key. Because the delta trail of each account is queryable, a farm that reuses one set of vouchers is flagged instantly. Sponsors also post a bond that burns if their recruit is proven fake, so the vault price of each clone rises with every round.
